findings.issue: Active jobs metric vs list empty
findings.detail: Server dashboard-summary jobs.active counted all non-terminal statuses; frontend execution tile excluded waiting-on-client bucket. Section header used API total_assigned, producing '(1 assigned)' with empty active list.

findings.issue: Show all active jobs dead link
findings.detail: Empty-state copy assumed a sub-filter was active; when filter was already 'all' and all jobs were in waiting-on-client, the link called setActiveJobFilter('all') as a no-op.

findings.issue: Urgent actions says up to date while waiting on landlord
findings.detail: urgentItems only counted executable push actions; waiting-on-client jobs (open_job_detail only) were ignored.

findings.issue: Drawer next action Open job when already open
findings.detail: contractorListPrimaryAction selected open_job_detail as primary CTA; executeContractorAction only re-set detailId.
propose_schedule and contractor next_actions did not gate on quote approval for QUOTE_FIRST workflow_mode (runtime probe HTTP 200 on AWAITING_QUOTE job).
POST /jobs/{id}/approve-quote returned 200 on staging for QUOTED job b5d9adc2; not a silent failure in API path tested.

remediation_applied: work_order_schedule_service: block contractor propose before quote approval on QUOTE_FIRST
ContractorDashboardPage: urgent waiting copy, active empty state, drawer waiting presentation
JobPage: waiting presentation for open_job_detail-only state
